test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 9 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Consummate
solution:
The correct answer is Inept.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word 'consummate' means 'showing great skill and flair'.
 
• Let's consider each option-
 
 
• Inept- Having or showing no skill; clumsy.
 
• Ideal- Satisfying one's conception of what is perfect; most suitable.
 
• Soothing- Having a gently calming effect.
 
• Worrisome- Causing anxiety or concern.
 
 
 
• Hence, the most appropriate antonym of the word 'consummate' is 'inept'.
 
• Thus, option 1 is the correct answer.
